description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains related to deadlock scenarios, including non-reentrant and reentrant grains, as well as a call chain reentrancy grain for testing reentrancy and deadlock conditions.

classes.name: DeadlockGrain
classes.description: Internal static class providing recursive call logic for deadlock testing.

classes.name: DeadlockNonReentrantGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant Orleans grain that participates in deadlock scenarios, with methods to call next grains.

classes.name: DeadlockReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain that participates in deadlock scenarios, with methods to call next grains.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that manages call chains with different reentrancy policies for testing reentrancy and deadlocks.

methods.name: CallNext
methods.description: Recursive static method to call the next grain in a call chain, handling blocking and reentrant grains.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Method in non-reentrant grain to invoke the next call in the chain.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Method in non-reentrant grain to invoke the next call in the chain.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Method in reentrant grain to invoke the next call in the chain.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Method in reentrant grain to invoke the next call in the chain.

methods.name: CallChain
methods.description: Method in CallChainReentrancyGrain to execute a chain of calls with different reentrancy policies.

methods.name: UnblockWaiters
methods.description: Method to unblock waiting tasks in CallChainReentrancyGrain.
